how_generated: 480 tokens; at every position from index 4 on, 16 candidates are drawn and the one whose n-gram carries the most g-bits wins (random.Random(seed=1103)). This reproduces SynthID tournament sampling with a uniform proposal distribution.
why_it_matters: Long marked text. mean-g must stay ~0.78 and not drift with length -- a check that accumulates instead of averaging would show length dependence here.
